title: Peacock Is Testing Out a Rewards Program for Subscribers - CNET
summary: Subscribers can also tap into Engagement rewards (based on app activity) or Experiential rewards, which are designed to give fans real experiences within the NBCUniversal world. While Peacock’s rewards program doesn’t cost extra for subscribers, some offers may have small fees attached.
